name: Scav Birthday Party
teaser: Based off the Grunt Birthday Party easter egg in halo. The all new Scav Birthday Party for tarkov!
description_html:
This mod adds the classic Grunt Birthday Party easter egg to tarkov. Custom created confetti particle effect along with the hooray sound will play on enemy kill. Almost all settings can be changed in game. Head shots only, confetti amount, confetti force, confetti chance, and horray volume will update without need to restart the game.

Leave a comment if you encounter any problems with the mod and I will see what I can do. Thank you!

Download Instructions

Download link will take you to the releases on Github.

Download ScavBirthdayParty.zip(If you are playing with FIKA download ScavBirthdayPartyFIKA.zip)

Extract the zip and drop the BepInEx folder where your SPT.Launcher is located.

Settings

F12 is the default key to change mod configs in game.

Enable Confetti Effect: Confetti will spawn on enemy kill.

Enable Hooray Sound: Hooray sound will play on enemy kill.

**Only on HeadShots:**The effect and sound will only play on headshot.

**Confetti Amount:**Determines how much confetti will be created.(1024 Max)

Confetti Force: Determines the amount of force confetti will have when spawned.

Confetti Chance: Determines chance confetti will spawn on kill.

**Hooray Volume:**Volume control for the hooray sound effect.

Known Problems

**Bodies Slide Around:**In my testing this has to do with the particles collision. I’m looking for a solution.
